objective: Retest given-text speech after wiring existing Flow chunk graph capture, preserving the prior streaming/nonstreaming workload and runtime conditions.
source: Same candidate source and same H100 allocation. Two sequential fresh servers: chunk_cuda_graph_max_streams=0 then8; existing whole-sequence Flow graph config remains unchanged. Each condition repeats the original stream=false versus stream=true workload.
reference: Pinned checkpoint assets/HT_ref_audio.wav, SHA256 recorded by CPU preflight; same default voice for both samples and arms.

configuration.graph_compile: Current defaults for whole-sequence Flow; only chunk_cuda_graph_max_streams varies0versus8.

endpoint: /v1/audio/speech over localhost; PCM16 mono 24kHz; stream mode uses SSE to identify generated chunks.
schedule: One H100 allocation; real CUDA graph/eager tests first; fresh server with chunk graph cap0, then fresh server withcap8. Each server uses disjoint fresh compiler caches,8warmup+48measured requests, two ABBA mode repeats per scenario, same250ms stagger.
primary_metric: Meaningful-audio arrival time: first received10ms PCM window with RMS>=0.001 fullscale.
secondary_metrics: simulated playback stall count/time with100ms buffer reserve
output_work: Experiment-only adapter writes full codec count, SHA256 and token IDs from existing CPU tensor once per request, shared in both modes.
validity: Fail fast first request failure and preserve partial evidence.
No aggregation that silently excludes failed requests.
Exact per-sample codec hashes checked; mismatches prevent strict matched-work speedup attribution.
Continuous output means multiple ordered audio deltas for each request before own terminal event; simulated buffer stalls do not establish perceptual audio quality.
Both conditions must complete the exact workload before comparison.
Graph evidence must cover all28completedstreamingrequests percondition; measured graph use checked after timings.
SameGPU condition order is disabledthenenabled; no reversed condition repeat, so condition-order drift remains a limitation.
exclusions: No claimed GPU overlap without GPU traces
No ASR/MOS or speaker similarity evaluation
No cancel/fault injection during measured timing cohorts

previous_run.role: Historical reference only; primary new comparison is cap0versuscap8withinoneGPUallocation.

gpu_validation: Existing test_flow_ragged.py -m accelerator real CUDA graph/eager parity and ragged cases before server startup; timeout180s, any failure stops serving runs.
graph_evidence: Identical experiment-only in-memory shape counters in both conditions; no hot-loop logging or file I/O. One cumulative snapshot at completed streaming request terminal. Post-timing verification subtracts startup/warmup counters and requires measured hits when enabled and zero hits with nonzero misses when disabled.
